Greetings Priya,

Daily digest – Fri, 23 Oct 2026
Jira:
- EIT-9286 – Move SIS onboarding milestones and KDM stakeholder mapping usecases from Billing Service to Portal Service v4
  https://ei-study.atlassian.net/browse/EIT-9286
- EIT-8383 – Enhance the OpenAPI spec writer skill with lessons from the consolidated services' OpenAPI refinements
  https://ei-study.atlassian.net/browse/EIT-8383
- EIT-8403 – Move billing profiles and user credits usecases from Identity Service to Billing Service
  https://ei-study.atlassian.net/browse/EIT-8403
- EIT-9333 – Harden the Attempt Service automated tests and document every test case in an Excel sheet
  https://ei-study.atlassian.net/browse/EIT-9333
- EIT-9334 – Harden the Billing Service test suite and document every automated test case
  https://ei-study.atlassian.net/browse/EIT-9334

Project: Platform Consolidation
Team members: [missing: who you worked with]

In short: Moved SIS onboarding milestones and KDM stakeholder mapping from Billing to Portal Service v4 across portal, billing, gateway, portal-ui and canon-data. Suites passed: portal-service-v4 1096/1096, billing 714/714, gateway 1205/1205, portal-ui 999/999. Quiz-service and billing test-hardening commits landed on their feature branches and were pushed. Nothing in today's evidence was deployed. EIT-9286 is in Review; EIT-9333 and EIT-9334 are In Progress; EIT-8403 and EIT-8383 stayed in Review with no new commits.
Day rating: [ask: rate your day 1 / 3 / 7 / 9]

1. Done today
   1. EIT-9286 – Move SIS onboarding milestones and KDM stakeholder mapping to Portal Service v4
      - Removed the SIS milestone and KDM families from billing, dropped milestone tables and KDM rows from the schema, and left those loads to the portal migrator.
      - Added portal migration 00010 for milestones and KDM, catalogue and APIs for order milestones, KDM contacts and contact roles, and published OpenAPI for them.
      - Portal migrator now loads legacy SIS milestones and KDM contacts/roles from ordermanagement and usermanagement, and is documented as re-runnable with remotion carry-over.
      - Gateway routes milestone and KDM resources to portal-service-v4, writes order-create KDMs with a replay queue, composes configurations and milestones_ready, and purges portal data after a billing order purge.
      - Portal UI reads and saves order KDM contacts in the portal format, keeps user-only KDMs by identity user id, and warns when the gateway saved the order but not its signatory.
      - Canon-data moved SIS contract milestones and order KDM contacts into the portal catalog and aligned milestone units with the portal API.
      - Verified with suite runs: portal-service-v4 1096/1096, billing 714/714, gateway 1205/1205, portal-ui 999/999.
      - Pushed on docs/openapi-descriptions, feat/billing-migrator, nav-aggregator-integration, migration and update/canon-refresh; no PR for these branches appears in today's evidence.
      - Jira moved To Do → In Progress → Review; due date set to 2026-10-27.
   2. EIT-9333 – Harden Attempt Service automated tests and document every test case
      - Stored quiz-service ids as uuid, strengthened weak tests, rejected parent attempt cycles, set aside legacy level logs with equal old and new levels, and ran Go unit and integration tests in Bitbucket Pipelines.
      - Typed quiz-service ids as uuid in the attempt catalog in canon-data.
      - go test: 8/8 packages passed.
      - Jira moved To Do → In Progress; due date set to 2026-10-27.
      - Excel documentation of every automated test case is still to confirm; no sheet artifact appears in the facts.
   3. EIT-9334 – Harden the Billing Service test suite and document every automated test case
      - Scoped Idempotency-Key replays to the first request, added a five-field cron schedule matcher, cluster-wide job lock and invoice raise ledger, and raise-once first-installment Zoho invoicing.
      - Added Postgres-backed tests for the invoice cron lock and ledger, and ran the Postgres and migrator suites in CI.
      - jest: 714/714 tests passed.
      - Jira moved To Do → In Progress; due date set to 2026-10-27.
      - Excel documentation attach to Jira is still open; the agent session reported the gateway could not read the local workbook.
   4. Testing
      - quiz-service go: 8/8 packages pass (at 15:11)
      - billing-service jest: 714/714 tests pass (at 20:32)
      - api-gateway jest: 1205/1205 tests pass (at 12:41)
      - portal-ui karma: 999/999 tests pass (at 14:31)
      - portal-service-v4 jest: 1096/1096 tests pass (at 14:38)
      - unknown-repo go: 3/3 tests pass (at 16:21)
      - unknown-repo jest: 1217/1217 tests pass (at 14:56)
      - unknown-repo playwright: 6/10 tests pass (2 failed, 2 skipped at 17:19)
   5. Commits
      - Atomic-commit check: [missing: result of the atomic-commit check skill]
      - quiz-service (5): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/commits/branch/feat%2Fattempt-migrator
      - canon-data (4): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/canon-data/commits/branch/update%2Fcanon-refresh
      - billing-service (24): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/billing-service/commits/branch/feat%2Fbilling-migrator
      - api-gateway (24): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/api-gateway/commits/branch/nav-aggregator-integration
      - portal-ui (8): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/portal-ui/commits/branch/migration
      - portal-service-v4 (33): https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/portal-service-v4/commits/branch/docs%2Fopenapi-descriptions

2. Plan vs actual (against the 19 Oct five-day plan, day 5 of 5)
   1. Implement the use-case documents for the consolidated services → Partly: portal OpenAPI and use-case docs for milestones, KDM contacts and contact roles were published and documented; broader consolidated-service use-case work beyond this move is not evidenced as newly finished today.
   2. Fix the DB migration scripts needed for those use-case changes → Done: migration 00010 for milestones and KDM, billing schema drops, and portal migrator stages for legacy SIS milestones and KDMs landed and were pushed.
   3. Apply the matching client-side fixes for the same changes → Done: api-gateway routes and composition for milestones/KDM, and portal-ui KDM read/save flows, were committed and pushed.
   4. Test the client-side applications end to end → Partly: unit suites passed (portal-ui 999/999, gateway 1205/1205, portal-service-v4 1096/1096, billing 714/714); a playwright run was 6/10 passed with 2 failed and 2 skipped, so full E2E for the move is not closed from facts alone.
   5. Close gaps found in testing and sync with Rahul on the OpenAPI writing guide → Partly: many gap-fix commits landed on the move branches; no fact shows a Rahul sync on the guide today.
   Extra, not in the plan: Quiz-service and billing test hardening (EIT-9333, EIT-9334), including billing invoice-cron lock/ledger work and CI for Postgres/migrator suites.

3. Schedule
   1. On schedule: EIT-9286 in Review, due 2026-10-27.
   2. On schedule: EIT-9333 and EIT-9334 In Progress, due 2026-10-27.
   3. Behind: EIT-8403 due 2026-10-23, still Review, no commits today; migration comment posted, deployment still to confirm.
   4. Behind: EIT-8383 due 2026-10-23, still Review, no commits today; skill-update comment posted.

4. Blockers
   1. Pushed EIT-9286 work has no PR in today's evidence, so review has not started on those branches.
   2. EIT-9334 Excel sheet was not attached to Jira; agent session reported the gateway could not read the local file.

5. Risks
   1. Milestone/KDM schema drops, migration 00010 and legacy data copies are pushed but not deployed — owner me, check Mon 26 Oct.
   2. Large multi-repo move sits on long feature branches without PRs, so review and rollback path for QA/Staging are unclear — owner me, Mon 26 Oct.
   3. Playwright run ended 6/10 passed with 2 failed and 2 skipped — owner me, recheck Mon 26 Oct.
   4. First remote run of the new Postgres and migrator CI step may fail on pipeline/Docker setup rather than tests — owner me, check Mon 26 Oct.

6. Decisions made
   1. Moved both SIS milestones and KDM use cases to portal-service-v4 and left billing without those families.
   2. Portal owns the legacy migrator stages for milestones and KDMs rather than billing.
   3. Quiz-service ids are stored and typed as uuid, with non-uuid rejection implied by the hardening commits.

7. Releases and deployment – None.

8. PRs and review turnaround
   1. quiz-service PR #3 "EIT-495 part 1 : Repo scaffolding, shared infrastructure, and OpenAPI common specifications" EIT-495-part-1-foundation → development, OPEN, opened 28 May 15:18; no approval yet, open for 149d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/pull-requests/3
   2. quiz-service PR #4 "EIT-495 (Part 2/5): pedagogy BC vertical slice + shared port interfaces" EIT-495-part-2-pedagogy → EIT-495-part-1-foundation, OPEN, opened 28 May 15:20; no approval yet, open for 149d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/pull-requests/4
   3. quiz-service PR #5 "EIT-495 (Part 3/5): contentattempt BC vertical slice" EIT-495-part-3-contentattempt → EIT-495-part-2-pedagogy, OPEN, opened 28 May 15:23; no approval yet, open for 149d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/pull-requests/5
   4. quiz-service PR #6 "EIT-495 (Part 4/5): application BC sources + top-level router" EIT-495-part-4-application-sources → EIT-495-part-3-contentattempt, OPEN, opened 28 May 15:26; no approval yet, open for 149d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/pull-requests/6
   5. quiz-service PR #7 "EIT-495 (Part 5/5): application BC tests + per-BC mocks" EIT-495-part-5-application-tests → EIT-495-part-4-application-sources, OPEN, opened 28 May 15:28; no approval yet, open for 149d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/pull-requests/7
   6. identity-service PR #312 "feat: Add browser-close logout type" EIT-6685 → master, OPEN, opened 05 Oct 14:57; no approval yet, open for 19d 5h – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/identity-service/pull-requests/312
   7. Branches with today's commits and no PR:
      - quiz-service feat/attempt-migrator – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/quiz-service/commits/branch/feat%2Fattempt-migrator
      - canon-data update/canon-refresh – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/canon-data/commits/branch/update%2Fcanon-refresh
      - billing-service feat/billing-migrator – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/billing-service/commits/branch/feat%2Fbilling-migrator
      - api-gateway nav-aggregator-integration – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/api-gateway/commits/branch/nav-aggregator-integration
      - portal-ui migration – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/portal-ui/commits/branch/migration
      - portal-service-v4 docs/openapi-descriptions – https://bitbucket.org/ei-india-admin/portal-service-v4/commits/branch/docs%2Fopenapi-descriptions

9. Learnings
   1. Quiz-service hardening had to add uuid id storage and parent-cycle rejection after weak tests were strengthened.
   2. Billing invoice cron needed a cluster-wide lock and raise-once ledger before it was safe to schedule.
   3. ei-mcp-gateway could not attach a local Mac Excel workbook to Jira from the remote gateway.

10. How I use AI tools and check quality
   1. Claude Code drove the EIT-9286 move across portal, billing, gateway, portal-ui and canon-data; a second session hardened quiz-service tests; a third rebased and pushed billing test/cron hardening.
   2. Checks: quiz-service go 8/8 packages; billing jest 714/714; gateway jest 1205/1205; portal-ui karma 999/999; portal-service-v4 jest 1096/1096; playwright 6/10 passed (2 failed, 2 skipped).

11. Plan for upcoming days
   1. Mon 26 Oct: Raise short-lived PRs from the pushed EIT-9286 branches for Rahul review (owner: me).
   2. Mon 26 Oct: Leave only one of EIT-9333 / EIT-9334 In Progress; finish Excel docs and attach or link the sheets (owner: me).
   3. Mon 26 Oct: Recheck playwright failures and confirm deployment/rollback notes before any QA push of the milestone/KDM move (owner: me).
   4. Tue 27 Oct: EIT-9286 due — close review comments and agree ship path with Daniel or Rahul (owner: me).
   5. Tue 27 Oct: EIT-9333 and EIT-9334 due — complete hardening verification rounds (owner: me).
   6. Wed 28 Oct: Clear EIT-8403 deployment pending items and log linked Bugs for the credits defects (owner: me).
